name: Hylie
source:
The Free-spirited Sylph
A young man of the Sylph Tribe.
He can hear the voice of the wind and possesses an extremely gentle and kind disposition.
He’s free-spirited and will never stay in the same location for long.
He has an extremely keen interest and admiration for things he doesn’t know. He approaches you at first out of interest in the fact that you are human.

“Quit trying to do something boorish like catch the wind.”
